milestones.title: Script Kiddie (Proud)
milestones.joke: A renewal script that reinstalls too.
milestones.when: shell: the renewal script `renew-and-reload.sh` run by hand, exit 0 (existence and the executable bit are not checked separately)

milestones.title: It Actually Installs
milestones.when: verify: demo-app now serves your hostname a different certificate than the one it served after Lab 2 (the service remembers serials while it runs; a service restart starts a new baseline, and a re-issue in Lab 3 counts)

milestones.title: Set It and Forget It
milestones.when: shell: `crontab -e` (saved, exit 0) or `crontab -l`; the entry itself is not read

milestones.title: Watched a Pot Boil
milestones.joke: You saw the renewal fire by itself.
milestones.when: verify: after the cron entry exists, the certificate served for your hostname changes again (renewal by cron or by hand cannot be told apart: the cron log is not read)
